title: ajuga ovalifolia var. angustifolia
intro: Ajuga ovalifolia var. angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaved bugleweed, is a perennial plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and hypertension, due to its potential health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and vasodilatory effects, which may help to reduce stress, alleviate muscle spasms, and improve blood circulation. The bioactive constituents of Ajuga ovalifolia var. angustifolia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
